answer: In an agent economy%2C Sybil resistance can work by requiring each identity to lock a deposit of scarce physical-resource derivatives%2C such as tokenized copper and basalt%2C verified through a distributed nebula of peer oracles. An attacker wanting many fake agents must purchase and lock multiples of these limited materials%2C driving up their market price and making large-scale identity farming economically prohibitive because the marginal cost rises with demand while honest agents only pay once.
